## Requirement and purpose

Refs #<issue>. Explain the user-visible behaviour and acceptance criteria.

## Validation

Record the command, result, tested SHA and CI run link. Describe negative and persistence cases.

## Independent review

Record a non-author teammate's substantive review and any resulting revision. Do not merge without actual approval of the latest revision.

## Limits and contribution

State unfinished scope and acknowledge reused/generated material. Link each contributor's actual activity.
